description: This file defines a Presenter class 'ProgressChartPresenter' that creates and binds a bar chart representing weekly calorie data in an Android TV frontend. It constructs a bitmap with axes, bars, and labels based on 'ProgressEntry' data, and sets this bitmap on an ImageCardView.

classes.name: ProgressChartPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter subclass that renders a simple bar chart visualization of calorie data over the last 7 days.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes an ImageCardView for displaying the chart.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a list of ProgressEntry data to a bitmap visualization of a bar chart, then sets it on the ImageCardView.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image bitmap from the view to free resources.
